_howToUpdate: VIDEOS — one video per player for the whole round, keyed by their name in players.json:
The value takes a bare ID or a pasted URL (youtu.be, watch?v=, /shorts/).
For a title or a note under the video use the long form instead:
The tile is always headed by the player's name; title captions the video below it.
Everyone on the roster gets a tile either way, reading "Video coming" until theirs is up.
Names are matched ignoring case and surrounding spaces; the console says which ones matched nobody.
VERDICT — the group's overall score for the course, out of 10:
Both fields are optional; leave `verdict` off entirely and nothing is shown.
This is separate from the per-player reviews below and is never averaged with them.
REVIEWS — one entry per player, keyed by their name in players.json:
condition and fun are 1-5. thoughts is free text. All three are optional.
Course averages and who still owes a review are worked out from these.
PHOTO — point `photo` at a real image in images/ and it shows above the course.
Leave it off (or on the placeholder SVG) and no image is rendered at all.

verdict.thoughts: Handsome course in good nick, and the front nine is a pleasure. The back nine has teeth and there's water waiting everywhere you don't want it. Worth playing again, ideally with a calmer group.

Joel.title: Joel front nine at Sand GCC

Niklas.title: Niklas front nine at Sand GCC

Joel.thoughts: The first nine was genuinely fun. Then the back nine happened, I lost my temper and threw the clubs in the water, so that's where the recording stops.

Niklas.thoughts: Loved the place right up until it started raining cats and dogs — and every umbrella we own was sitting in the car.
